::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** 10 Aug. 1867.  
**Manuscript:** Copy outletter book British Library Add MSS.55387 (1): P. 463
:::

Dear Miss Yonge	
I suppose you [*illegible*] the <u>translation</u> of Alexandre Dumas & after some difficulty we have a shabby copy which I am sending by post.

We will be glad to have the whole [M.S.](cmy_books/cmybook_72.qmd) when it is ready. You can either send it to [Miss Martin](people/person_971.qmd) or to us

Yours very [*illegible*]
[Geo Lillie Craik](people/person_379.qmd)
